except_prefix.description: Values starting with this prefix are never replaced: director-issued bcw- ids stay stable (RING0 §4).

target.description: For jsonpath: an RFC 9535 path using only the root $, child .name, descendant ..name and wildcard [*] segments, so a stdlib applier can match it. For run_value: the name of a run value (sandbox_root or director_port) that the masking caller supplies; every occurrence of that value is replaced by the placeholder, except inside a director-issued id (bcw- and 16 lowercase hex digits, keyed.mint_id), which stays stable (RING0 §4).
